pre_result_corrections.trigger: contract workflow #1 failed in --preflight-only before any cap>1 construction
pre_result_corrections.correction: do not infer defensive scale from independently banded published V1/BRRK holdings; rebuild frozen raw V1 target and BRRK-0011 scale from the canonical research authority
evaluation return session t uses the accepted target from decision day t-1; the full-BRRK evaluation session 2022-12-10 therefore starts from decision date 2022-12-09

published_daily_weights.role: legacy banded-holdings evidence only; never a defensive-scale source

historical_input.price_source: Binance spot 1d closes via frozen research/core/crypto_rotation_backtest.py fetch_daily
historical_input.decision_timing: target dated t is held over the next UTC daily return session t+1
historical_input.pre_brrk_stress_proxy: frozen V1 raw target with defensive_scale=1.0; proxy only, never promotion-performance evidence

defensive_scale_recovery.authority: rebuild from frozen BRRK-0011 research source, not published banded-holdings ratios
defensive_scale_recovery.raw_brrk_target: frozen V1 raw target multiplied by rebuilt defensive scale
defensive_scale_recovery.cap1_preflight: legacy apply_band(raw BRRK,0.05) + prior-day holding timing must reproduce frozen BRRK-0011 baseline metrics before any cap>1 construction

p3_3_rebalance_adapter.current_weights_definition: current economic asset notionals divided by current account equity immediately before the daily decision
p3_3_rebalance_adapter.partial_fill_scenario: when enabled, execute exactly 50% of desired weight delta at a triggered rebalance; remainder stays prior exposure until next legal daily decision

transaction_cost.legacy_baseline_continuity: frozen legacy BRRK applies 5% target-vs-last-accepted-target band to raw BRRK then shift(1) into the evaluation session
transaction_cost.matched_comparator: candidate must also be compared with a cap=1 path using the same P3.3 economic-drift adapter
transaction_cost.promotion_comparator_rule: candidate must satisfy mandatory economic gates versus both frozen legacy BRRK and matched P3.3 cap1 where comparable

primary.BTC_base: verified spot up to matched cap1 held BTC economic weight
primary.BTC_extra: perp overlay above matched cap1 held BTC economic weight

routing_and_funding.all_perp: stress panel only; not sole primary implementation economics
routing_and_funding.daily_funding_factor: product over same-UTC-day blocks of (1 - sum(perp_weight_i * rate_i_block))
routing_and_funding.spike_rule: multiply adverse positive Hyperliquid funding rates only; favorable credits are unchanged
routing_and_funding.binance_proxy: report sign/regime/full-history stress only; never substitute for Hyperliquid level

degraded_execution.capacity_evidence: P2 audited point-in-time route/depth evidence only; never represented as historical PIT liquidity

synthetic_stress.vol_block_selection: worst realized 20-day blocks selected from matched cap1 5bps full-BRRK path, never candidate-specific
synthetic_stress.vol_block_overlap_rule: select three lowest compounded-return 20d matched-cap1 windows greedily, rejecting overlaps; earlier start breaks ties

operating_budget.selection: smallest candidate budget covering main 5bps historical maxDD and mandatory FULL_BRRK historical stress-window maxDD

broad_region.rule: a >1 candidate can be promotion-eligible only if it passes all mandatory gates and at least one adjacent >1 preregistered cap also passes

benchmark_cost_semantics.btc_buy_and_hold: charge initial acquisition turnover at the same bps scenario; no later rebalancing cost
benchmark_cost_semantics.four_asset_equal_weight_buy_and_hold: charge initial 100% acquisition turnover at the same bps scenario; no later rebalancing cost
benchmark_cost_semantics.cash: zero return unless a separately preregistered benchmark says otherwise

funding_and_execution_pass_rules.primary_native_funding_spikes: candidate must not breach 70% catastrophe or liquidate and must finish at or above the matched P3.3 cap1 path under the same native-funding spike mechanics; frozen legacy common-window economics are reported separately but do not control this execution-semantics-matched gate
funding_and_execution_pass_rules.all_perp: report-only stress for relative economics; mandatory pass is no 70% catastrophe and no modeled liquidation
funding_and_execution_pass_rules.binance_proxy: report-only sign/regime stress; no Hyperliquid-level selection threshold
funding_and_execution_pass_rules.degraded_fill: candidate must not breach 70% catastrophe, must not hit modeled capacity failure, and must finish at or above matched cap1 under the same degraded mechanics

capacity_snapshot.use: point-in-time capacity evidence only; never historical PIT liquidity
capacity_snapshot.workflow_behavior: one-time runner downloads the pinned artifact with repository GITHUB_TOKEN before evaluation and copies the exact capacity input + digest into immutable result evidence

selection_implementation.20bps_not_dominated: candidate fails if either matched cap1 or frozen legacy comparator has both >= terminal multiple and >= max_drawdown (shallower) with at least one strict
